view.columnInfo: This navigation sets up a designated column in the footer. The navigation name will be displayed as a headline for the column. All categories on the first level below this navigation are displayed as rows below the column headline.

types.title: Category type
types.linkUnavailable: Link (not selectable if navigation is defined as entry point)
types.help: A structure navigation is not callable by itself, but is only used for outlining purposes.

helpText.page: A page / list has associated products and can be accessed directly with the assigned layout.
helpText.folder: A structuring element / entry point will only be displayed in the structure if it has children and is not directly accessible except it is assigned as an entry point of a Channel.
helpText.link: A link allows for reference to a product, another navigation, a landing page or an external site.

entry-point-card.existingNavigationDescription: You have assigned this navigation as an entry point for the main navigation in these Channels:

types.helpTextMainNavigation: The entry point for the main navigation is a mandatory field for Channels. If you assign this navigation as the entry point for the Main navigation to one or more Channels, you can only change this assignment on the channel itself.
types.helpTextFooterNavigation: If you assign this navigation as the entry point for the Footer navigation to one or more Channels, the categories on the next level will be columns. This allows you to divide your footer navigation into several areas.
types.helpTextServiceNavigation: If you assign this navigation as the entry point for the Service navigation to one or more Channels, the categories on the next level will be displayed as a second navigation in the footer area.

entry-point-modal.mainNavigationNameHelpText: By default this navigation is displayed as "home". Enter an alternative display name if the default configuration doesn't fit the current Channel.

seo.title: SEO
seo.helpTextMetaTitle: Meta titles should not be longer than 70 characters. Excess text will be truncated by Google and the title will not be fully displayed in the SERP snippet.
seo.helpTextMetaDescription: The possible length for meta descriptions on Google is about 175 characters and is trimmed according to pixel width. However, it is recommended to aim for a length of about 150 characters so that the description is not cut off in the SERP snippet. HeyFrame allows a maximum length of 255 characters.
